items.heading: Green Fig and Saltfish
details: Key ingredients: green bananas, salted codfish, tomato, onion
Boil green bananas (figs) until tender.
Soak and flake salted codfish.
Saute the fish with tomato, onion and peppers.
Serve the saucy fish over the sliced green bananas.

items.heading: Bouyon
details: Key ingredients: meat, dumplings, root vegetables, plantain
Simmer meat with root vegetables and plantain in a large pot.
Add dumplings made from flour and water.
Cook until the vegetables and dumplings are tender.
Serve the thick, hearty stew hot.

items.heading: Lambi
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
